'''Shasa Tiel''' was an [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] who worked for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], before later being blackmailed into working for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
The [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] Shasa Tiel was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the<ref name="DB" /> [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Tibrin">{{CSWECite|III|244|Tibrin}}</ref> [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]].<ref name="DB" /> Tiel did accounting work for the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] on the planet [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]],<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|60|Who's Who in Jabba's Palace}}</ref> before leaving the company. She was blackmailed into working for the<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Shasa Tiel}}</ref> [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]<ref name="Jabba">{{FactFile|38|JAB 1-4|Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]],<ref name="CCG" /> serving under the<ref name="DB" /> [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] accountant<ref name="ccgMosep">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Mosep}}</ref> [[Mosep Binneed/Legends|Mosep Binneed]]<ref name="DB" /> as his<ref name="ccgMosep" /> assistant.<ref name="CCG" /> Tiel also operated as a financial advisor to Jabba,<ref name="DB" /> though she hated her [[Time/Legends|time]] working for the Hutt.<ref name="Who's Who" />

Tiel was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], asleep on [[Jabba the Hutt's dais/Legends|Jabba's dais]], when [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] disguised as [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]], attempted to free [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from carbonite. She later witnessed [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] encounter with the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] and was aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] when the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] broke out.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> Tiel rejoiced that Jabba never returned from the expedition, which ended with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] and the ''Khetanna''{{'s}} destruction.<ref name="Who's Who" />

==Personality and traits==
Tiel loathed Jabba<ref name="DB" /> and hated her job.<ref name="CCG" /> She desperately<ref name="DB" /> sought out a means of escape<ref name="CCG" /> and rejoiced that Jabba never returned from the Great Pit of Carkoon.<ref name="Who's Who" /> The [[Gender/Legends|female]] Ishi Tib had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, orange [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="DB" /> and was considered to be rather ugly.<ref name="ROTJW65">[[Return of the Jedi Weekly 65|''Return of the Jedi Weekly'' 65]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A photo of Tiel and others in Jabba's palace was used the roleplaying game book ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'' to represent a group of bounty hunters.<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>
